title: Tech Note: Creating a quick Report Wizard

historical_commentary.text: 4D's reporting architecture has continued to evolve well beyond the 2003 Report plug-in design discussed here, and building custom report wizards remains a relevant technique, though the specific plug-in architecture curiosity noted is now a historical detail rather than a practical concern for current 4D developers.
related_updates: 4D's reporting architecture (including the Quick Report engine and 4D Write Pro) has continued to evolve substantially since the 2003 Report plug-in design discussed here
